assumptions.falsified_by: Any consequence a reader knows of that the graph does not reach.
assumptions.name: graph_is_the_world
assumptions.statement: Every route by which the changed occurrence reaches its consequences is in the stated graph. A route the graph omits carries none of this change.
assumptions.why_needed: Propagation is graph surgery. It can only travel links that exist, so recall bounds the answer and nothing in the system can report what was missed (R-13).

assumptions.falsified_by: A domain expert naming a factor outside the ontology that produces both ends of any link in the chain.
assumptions.name: no_unobserved_confounder
assumptions.statement: No unobserved common cause explains the links this change travelled. If one does, the change moves nothing in the world and this figure is an artifact of the graph's shape.
assumptions.why_needed: The links here were derived from rules, temporal structure and frequency rather than identified as causal effects (prd.md §16, OQ-007). Nothing in V1 adjusts for a confounder, and module 9's flags LOCATE observed common causes without resolving any of them.

assumptions.falsified_by: Any adaptive response to the change -- anything that would have been done differently once the changed occurrence happened differently.
assumptions.name: the_rest_of_the_world_is_held_still
assumptions.statement: Nothing outside the stated change behaves differently. Every occurrence the change does not reach happens exactly as it did.
assumptions.why_needed: A simulated world is the historical world with a surgery applied. There is no forward process model here and prd.md §6 excludes one.

assumptions.falsified_by: A measurement of what each cause actually contributed, which would make the apportionment unnecessary rather than wrong.
assumptions.name: weights_are_apportionments
assumptions.statement: The share attributed to each cause of a consequence is a reasonable split of that consequence among the causes the engine happens to hold for it.
assumptions.why_needed: Every reduced magnitude is that share applied to a measured total. ATTRIBUTION_NOT_MEASUREMENT_NOTICE states the limit: two weights are comparable to each other and neither is a quantity of anything in the world.

validity.belief_absent_because: the change travelled no stated link, so there is no chain of belief to compose. This is an absence and not a belief of zero.

envelopes.detail: support cannot be judged for this move: the stated graph holds neither an antecedent nor a consequence for evt:3cd104d531e3b363, so there is no gap this run witnessed to judge a move against. That is different from the move leaving the data behind, and the two are kept apart so an unmeasured run cannot read as a measured one.

sensitivity.detail: no consequence carried a magnitude on both sides, so there is no figure to perturb. The sweep is reported as not runnable rather than as a finding that the answer is stable.

deltas.detail: evt:3cd104d531e3b363 happens at a different instant in this hypothetical.

events.magnitude_absent_because: the pack declares no magnitude measurement for SHIPMENT_DISPATCHED, so this consequence has no size to change. The COUNT is still a measurement and is reported; the size is not, and is not reported as zero.
